entries.04978a4f2f80fa0f: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥43,293 million. By segment, cheese accounted for ¥42,102 million, nuts for ¥641 million and other for ¥549 million.
entries.12d608a53dbd9774: Cheese is the core of revenue; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥42,102 million, accounting for most of consolidated revenue of ¥43,293 million. Nuts were ¥641 million and other products ¥549 million. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, and sales to principal customer Nippon Access, Inc. account for 48.9% of sales results.

entries.2bdeaf7724a0f50c: This business model involves manufacturing cheese at its own plants and other facilities and selling it to wholesalers and others, and also earning income from sales of nuts and bean snacks manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.2f2871084fe63e55: This segment's main business is the manufacture and sale of nuts and bean confectionery. Most products are manufactured and sold by consolidated subsidiaries Mitsuya Group Holdings Co., Ltd., Mitsuya Co., Ltd. and Sensei-do Co., Ltd., and the company sells some of them. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥641 million.
entries.302f121e5910f958: Cheese has been the core product since process cheese production began in 1958; it is manufactured at the Kobe and Nagano plants, combined with partial outsourcing to external processors. In the nuts business, by making the Mitsuya Group, formerly a manufacturing contractor, a wholly owned subsidiary, the group has established a system to handle nut and bean snack production through sales in-house. It has group companies in Indonesia and Vietnam engaged in cheese manufacturing and sales or sales only, and conducts business overseas.
entries.316d5af58190ab4a: The principal customer is Nippon Access, Inc., which accounted for 48.9% of sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 in relation to cheese.
entries.448ea98ca355afe3: This segment's main business is the manufacture and sale of cheese. The company manufactures and sells most of the products itself, and some are manufactured under contract by external processors, including related party Daily Products Solutions Co., Ltd., with the company selling them. The Kobe Plant and Nagano Plant are the main manufacturing sites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥42,102 million.

entries.8780b204f4f8d342: To put its management philosophy into practice, 'Contributing to society through the provision of a healthy, bright and enjoyable food culture,' the company has set a medium- to long-term management policy, 'Vision 2030', aiming for transformation into a 'high value-added creation company' by 2030. Through business growth and foundation-strengthening strategies under its Medium-Term Management Plan 2027, covering the three years from January 2025, it is working to expand revenue and raise corporate value, and in the nuts business says it will pursue growth strategies by creating synergies with the Mitsuya Group through sharing of management resources such as capital and personnel, new market development and expansion of overseas operations.
